title: The Lord's Promise to Solomon Regarding the Temple and the Royal Throne
description: The Lord appears to Solomon at night and promises to hear prayers offered in the temple, but also gives a conditional warning: If the people turn back, God will forgive and heal the land; however, if they abandon Him, He will reject the house and uproot them from the land [ref:2 Chr 7:12-22|2 Chronicles 7:12-22].
